mentions.speaker: Rich Fazo
mentions.quote: We're in Brooklyn, Crown Heights. I live, I've been living here for a while. I've been photographing here.

mentions.speaker: Rich Fazo
mentions.quote: I live not too far from Prospect Park. I go to the Prospect Park and walk around with camera.

mentions.speaker: Rich Fazo
mentions.quote: To Midtown. ... When you go to midtown, it's the same setup, medium format.

mentions.speaker: Rich Fazo
mentions.quote: Cuz midtown I shoot late, too, past 9, 10.

mentions.speaker: Rich Fazo
mentions.quote: I've done a good amount of stuff from the Puerto Rican Day Parade as well.
